brief: The canvas displays a deeply populated field of figures rendered in a style of visceral fragmentation. These subjects appear to be decomposing, not through smoke or dust, but by cleaving along stark geometric fault lines. These pathways are thick and flowing, stained with rich, oxidized crimson and deep, viscous bruise-purple, tracing the body’s structural failure. The shapes themselves are constantly shifting and vibrating, undergoing a slow, traumatic dissolution. While the base image remains intact, the entire scene subtly writhes and expands independently of any input, allowing the viewer to observe the perpetual process of emotional decay.

statement: This sketch depicts a visceral field of geometrically fragmented forms undergoing slow, organic decay. The composition consists of thousands of small, rotating spheres that gradually shift and dissolve toward the center of the scene, while thick, flowing crimson fault lines propagate across the canvas in unpredictable patterns. The visual effect captures the essence of emotional breakdown through stark, mechanical cleavages against a backdrop of organic motion—each fragment pulsing with its own rhythm of dissolution. The palette emphasizes rich reds and deep purples to convey a sense of trauma and transformation, creating an unsettling yet mesmerizing representation of internal collapse.
